deployment._comment: Deployment options for the NanoClaw kernel process

options.notes: RPi 4/5 with network access to both PCC gateway and OT-2. Install Node 22+, run kernel server on port 3100. Connect OT-2 via USB or Ethernet.
options.requirements: Node.js 22+, 2GB RAM, network to OT-2 (port 31950) and internet (PCC gateway)

options.notes: Run as a container on the DGX Spark (192.168.108.72). SSH in, start kernel process. OT-2 must be on same network or tunneled.
Deploy as a separate Railway service. OT-2 needs port forwarding or Tailscale/WireGuard tunnel.
options.requirements: Railway account, Dockerfile, OT-2 accessible via public IP or tunnel

dualNetwork._comment: The NanoClaw kernel can register on multiple PCC networks simultaneously
dualNetwork.how: The kernel-agent registers capabilities on each network's message bus. Set 'networks' array to list all networks. The gateway routes discovery requests across all registered networks.
